name: notification-hub-greenfield
title: Notification Hub Greenfield — Event-Driven Notification Microservice
description: Greenfield rewrite of the notification hub as a modern, portable microservice. Multi-tenant, multi-channel (push via ntfy, email, SMS, webhook), with device management, DND/quiet hours, rate limiting, templates, and delivery tracking. Subscribes to vrooli-events for event-driven notifications — no source scenario changes needed to enable notifications on any inter-scenario event. SQLite + file-based storage for portability.
